service_url.hint: Base URL of the Service without /api/v1.

service_api_key.hint: Use a workspace key whose principal can read and run.

agent_id.hint: The ID of a text-output Agent in this workspace.

bridge_key.hint: Generate a separate random key with at least 24 ASCII letters or digits. Copy it to the Dify API Key field.

port.hint: Set the Dify API Base to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.

timeout_seconds.hint: Set the Dify Runner timeout higher than this value.
